description: dreaming: sleep at compaction and at session end. PreCompact runs the consolidation BLOCKING (the session is asleep) with a one-hour ceiling; SessionEnd (capped at 60 s by Claude Code) decides in under a second and hands the sleep to a detached windowless child that outlives the session; SessionStart(compact) re-seeds the fresh context from the brief; SessionStart(resume) and the FIRST UserPromptSubmit of a session say how many dreams await promotion (never SessionStart(startup): it fires before the scheduled-task tag exists, so it could only guess who is waking). Every hook exits 0 on any failure; DREAMING_DISABLED=1 or enabled:false in ~/.dreaming/config.json or <project>/.dreaming.json silences all five.
